name: Sticky Case Simple
summary: A compact bumper case with side-button and USB-C cutouts for everyday carry.
description: A compact bumper case that wraps the edges of reTerminal Sticky and leaves the screen, side button, and USB-C port open. Print it in a flexible or rigid filament depending on the fit you prefer. The STL file is hosted by Seeed Studio on behalf of the author.

preview.alt: Sticky Case Simple printed and fitted on reTerminal Sticky
